derivation: For a recurrent object with invariant B and position scale: delta=(c7_frame2-c7_frame1)*B. This equals world-camera displacement if object translation is invariant. Agreement across distinct B/c7 pairs supports static-scene interpretation but cannot exclude common global scene motion.
limitations: Single captured occurrence does not prove object identity; content + B + scale constrain it.
Truncated frames provide only matched captured draws, never proof of absence.
Transform-pair dedup avoids counting submeshes/pixel-shader passes as independent objects.
Coordinate origin and absolute World translations remain underdetermined.
